about: Denning's corrections to the win-probability model. Kinds: direction (curve can only rise or fall: increasing true/false), drop (variable not used), interaction (always offer this pair, written 'a & b'), cap (effect limited to max_points). Each needs a reason. Every fit reports accuracy with and without them.

corrections.reason: Denning (agreeing with Claude's batch 3 finding): Lord damage only decides a match at 28:00 (the tiebreak); before that a team can deal a lot of Lord damage and still lose to a Lord kill, so Lord damage should be read together with the clock.
